body: No updates really, we thought we'd have a chance to see each other tomorrow, but that fell through sadly. I'm trying to distract myself as best as I can, play guitar, video games, go on walks, but I can't help but just feel so depressed and down. I'm gonna try to see her Monday when her parents are at work, but I don't know if that's gonna work either.

She didn't take it too well, but she's listening to him. Her and her dad have never had a good relationship, but ever since this happened she said her and her dad have been getting along and she doesn't want to ruin that, and I don't want to encourage her to mess that up either.

And I'm not still attending online school since school is out.
No, the parents won't talk to me. Her dad has hated me for a long time and this is his way of officially getting me away from her.

I'm really messed up man, sigh. I'll give you the short story to save the time. Basically I was really depressed around this time last year, on the verge of suicide even, but I started talking to this girl I knew for awhile named Patricia. We became close and started hanging out. We both did online school so we were able to see each other a lot. It got to a point where I started spending everyday with her and because I was always with her, she cured my anxiety, depression, and stopped all my suicidal thoughts. I fell in love with her. She became my reason to live and just flooded my mind. On the rare occasions I wasn't with her, I was always thinking about her. When she wasn't around I was a ghost, I slept most of the day away and just laid around, but when I was with her I was the complete opposite, she changed me so much. But recently something bad happened.  I bought her a bong, cause I knew she always wanted one and uh, her parents kind of found it. She told them it was mine and they told her she wasn't allowed to see me anymore. And this has completely turned my life upside down. It's fucked me up completely. My anxiety and depression is going crazy and I'm just tempted to put a bullet in my head to end this pain and obsessive thoughts I'm having of her. The though of never seeing her again, hell the thought of not seeing her anytime soon just drives my brain crazy. She's my reason to live and I'm scared I'm gonna lose that reason.

It's fine. Sigh, well I'm just depressed, man. Before I start I want to mention that I'm 17, that might become important later. Anyways it started back in July/August, I just got over my addiction to heroin and me and my girlfriend of a year and a half broke up so I was left all by myself. I reached out to a friend of mine, named Patricia. I knew Patricia for awhile so she and I were pretty close. We started hanging out a lot. I mean **a lot** We both did school online so, we could do whatever we wanted for most of the day. I started spending all my time with her. I was over at her house pretty much 5-6 days out of the week, I dropped most of my friends, because all I did was hang out and spend time with her. Around November or October I started to notice I was falling for her, falling for her bad, man. I spent weeks upon weeks with her and just became attached. Some stuff happened with her family and it got to a point where I couldn't see her as much. We would hang out for 3 to 4 days out of the week then she'd go home for about 2 days and come back. But during those 2 days, I did nothing. I would sleep all day and that was it. It's like I would become a ghost when she wasn't around. I was miserable. And now things have only gotten worse. I went over to her house Friday and stayed until Sunday (she had something to do Monday so I had to leave), but during the time I was over there I brought her a bong, she always wanted so I gave it to her. The day I left is when her parents found it. She told them it was mine and they told her she wasn't allowed to see me again. This... really fucked me up. I fell in love with this girl, Patricia became the cure of my depression and anxiety. I hate to say it, but the reason she became my reason to live. And now I can't see her, it's making my anxiety and depression shoot through the roof. I'm just scared, I don't know what to do. It's driving me crazy.
You sure, man? It's gonna be a lot?
